demos.name: Delegation Lab
demos.description: Consent mints a delegated token with act={agent}; the gateway validates the chain (actor allow-list, no upstream audience). Directory groups are read EVERY decision: outside the group is denied regardless of scopes; premium expands tools and ceiling. Mock of UC1/UC9/UC9A/UC21.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7690). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7690 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). The decision contract mirrors the AI-DEMO2 agentMcpTokenService + GatewayTokenPolicy + the simulatedAuthorizeService tier guard, enforced live 2026-11-06. Repo: curtismu7/delegation-lab-LAB. Catalog id D120 (assigned 2026-11-06).
